product.name: Pinzon Galaxy 28-Inch Table Lamp, Chrome
product.description: Modern design table lamp adds artistic complement as well as utility to any décor Chrome-plated metal base with shallow straight drum cotton shade; silver cord Requires 1 bulb up to 100 watts; UL listed; 1-way switch Some easy assembly required on arrival; other colors available Measures 28 inches high by 19 inches wide; weighs approximately 10 pounds
